title: Drag and drop: move a file between two file manager windows
instruction: Two file manager windows are open, one showing ~/bench/camera and one showing ~/bench/Album. Drag photo.png from the camera window into the Album window so the file moves there.
enforced: the change is made by the file manager process (fanotify writer audit), not by a shell; a cut-and-paste inside the file manager also passes (the checker cannot tell it from a drag)
